parts.name: Outer membrane
parts.line: The skin of the cell. It decides what gets in and out.

parts.name: Nucleus
parts.line: Holds most of the cell’s DNA.

parts.name: Endoplasmic reticulum
parts.line: Folded membranes where many proteins and fats are made.

parts.name: Mitochondria
parts.line: Turn fuel into the energy the cell spends.

parts.name: Endosomes
parts.line: Sort what the cell has taken in.

parts.name: Microtubules
parts.line: Stiff tubes that act as scaffolding and tracks.
